QuestInfo.name: [Limina] The Dark Knights
QuestInfo.0: The Black Mage's Elites appreared out of nowhere, but Orchid ignored them and took off. Now they're chasing after her, and she's definitely going to need your help.
QuestInfo.1: You must enter the portal above in #bWorld's Sorrow Midpoint 3#k, face the Black Mage's Elites, and head to the top of the waterfall.
QuestInfo.2: You reached the top of the waterfall, and fought off the Black Mage's Elites. Now you finally have a chance to talk to Orchid in #bFinal Horizon#k.
